newsitem.title: UK: NBC Europe sees ad revs growing 80-100 pct.
newsitem.headline: NBC Europe sees ad revs growing 80-100 pct.

text.p: NBC Europe, the London-based pan-European cable and satellite television channel, on Tuesday said its advertising revenue has more than doubled over the last year and it sees ad revenues growing 80 to 100 percent over the next 12 months.

"We'll be in the 80 to 100 percent range," Roger Odgen, president and managing director of NBC Europe told Reuters following a news conference. He told the news conference advertising revenues more than doubled over the past year and continue to be the channel's most important source of income.
NBC Europe in late July had said its advertising sales to date in 1996 were up 102 percent over the prior-year period.
"We've grown substantially in terms of our credibility," Ogden told Reuters.
The range of advertisers has been growing, branching out from travel to information technology.
Ogden said NBC Europe will soon annouce a sponsorship deal with consumer products company Procter & Gamble.
"We'll announce a deal pretty soon for a P&G product. It's a fragance," Ogden said.
